target: R08 grab/swing physics: sheet intersections, multi-layer yarn detachment, jelly-like response and craft integration
scope: Research, reproducible root-cause isolation and candidate unit-tested operators. No production runtime change in this stage.
forbiddenRoutes: Treating a closed visible mesh as proof of collision-safe dynamics
Treating finite positions, stretch limits or rendering success as complete physics acceptance
Making all materials rigid or merely increasing one stiffness constant to hide jelly behavior
Using disconnected tube stitches or substituting static images for the running product
Excluding different-layer contacts solely because their initial points are close
Assigning all segments of a multi-layer seam to one panel
Rotating anisotropic material axes with arbitrary triangle vertex numbering
Claiming native IPC test success means IPC is deployed in the browser
Claiming an intact old craft file means all craft mechanics are integrated into product dynamics
confirmedDefects: Original R08 misses an initially separated triangle-interior crossing at 0.5 m/s without any stretch explosion
All actual card-holder yarn binding entries use the front panel; the backside yarn ignores an isolated 1mm back-panel motion
Identical prescribed deformation yields different material energy under cyclic vertex reordering
Reference-thickness hinge coefficient is one third of the R04 formula for the same local geometry
Velocity damping coefficients and material integration differ from the preserved R04 experiment
verifiedNotMissing: Yarn shader reads the changing node texture during actual pointer grab
The archived R02 craft interface loads and contains actual controls
isolatedCorrections: Use explicit rest material-chart tangents, independent of triangle enumeration
Explicit front-carrier, hole-interior and back-carrier interpolation for a multi-layer yarn passage

researchEvidence.meaning: Green research assertions reproduce baseline failures and test isolated repairs. They do not certify the old or a new product physics runtime.

futureProductionGates: Initially feasible finite-thickness surface geometry and explicit seam adjacency
Swept point-triangle and edge-edge contact validation, not vertex spheres alone
Independent cross-layer yarn carrier tests and distance to the final visible skin during motion
Controlled loading, unloading, bending and decay comparisons against the R04 reference, with measured versus assumed parameters separated
Integrated craft geometry and contacts verified per applicable product
No change to accepted appearance, old archives or locked historical files
Only after full-product tests: actual standalone and fixed-public-URL browser checks, with mobile simulation distinguished from hardware
